prompt: Premium 16-bit pixel art for a cozy modern North American seaside exploration game. Carefully clustered pixels, restrained dark outlines, warm summer colors. Single isolated complete object on flat pure magenta #ff00ff, no ground, no cast shadow, no lettering, generous margins. One short coastal town wayfinding post with three wooden arrow slats pointing left, right and up, blank cream surfaces with teal edges and no writing, solid timber vertical post. A few weathered bolts. The signs are clearly separate and usable for adding labels in UI.
